title: Az ország újranépesítése a 18. században (Repopulating the Country)
grammar: Postpositions of Instrumentality (által, révén) and Enlightened Reforms

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say how and why the country was repopulated after the Ottoman wars.
I can use postpositions (által, révén) to explain methods and causes.
I can name the main groups of settlers who came in the 18th century.
I can use eight new words about the resettlement, such as telepes and sváb.
